newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says gas tariff to fall around 1 pct Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Spain says gas tariff to fall around 1 pct Tuesday.

text.p: Spanish gas tariffs for domestic and commercial use will fall around one percent from July 1, according to the official state bulletin published at the weekend.
The bulletin set out an overall decline of up to around three percent for industrial consumers of gas.
Those firms which used to pay what was known as a "specific tariff" -- up to 20 percent higher than the general industrial rate -- now pay the lower general tariff.
This affects around 13 percent of Gas Natural's industrial consumption, analysts said.
With this move, the tariff structure has been simplified overall, as foreseen by Industry Secretary Nemesio Fernandez Cuesta earlier this year.

Analysts said the effect of the fall in the domestic tariff was neutral for the results of sole gas supplier Gas Natural in the case of the domestic tariff. This is because the firm's raw material costs had fallen by a greater amount in the past year.

The effect of the fall in the industrial tariff, although negative for Gas Natural's results, had been fully discounted since the government publicised its plans, and was expected to be somewhat lower, analysts said.
No-one at the Industry Ministry was immediately available to comment.
